title: Six-Bed En-Suite HMO For Professionals
desc: An all en suite 6 bedroom HMO, finished to a high specification, located in Eastleigh.

listing.provenance: By HMO Designers, part of Thistle Group

writeup.approach: Each room is a self-contained unit rather than a bedroom with a shared bathroom down the hall: its own en suite behind an oak door, a slatted timber headboard panel wired with sockets and switches at the bed, a desk under the window, and a wardrobe and chest in cane-fronted oak. The en suites are tiled in large-format stone with quadrant showers and backlit round mirrors. Separate tea stations sit outside the rooms, which is the arrangement that keeps a scheme like this the right side of the licensing standards on kitchen provision.
writeup.outcome: Complete and photographed in September 2025. The palette is warm throughout, oak, cream, terracotta and mustard, which is a deliberate step away from the grey-and-white that most rooms at this rent level default to.

summary: The conversion of an existing family house in Eastleigh into a six-bedroom HMO for professional tenants, with every bedroom given its own en suite rather than sharing bathrooms. The property sits outside an Article 4 area, so the change from a C3 house to a C4 HMO did not need a full planning application.

Each room was designed as a self-contained space. The en suites are oak-framed, with large-format stone tiling, quadrant showers and backlit mirrors. Every bedroom has a slatted timber headboard panel with integrated sockets, a desk set at the window, and storage in cane-fronted oak wardrobes and chests. Tea stations sit outside the bedrooms so the layout stays within the licensing standards on kitchen facilities.

HMO Designers, part of Thistle Group, took the project through the Lawful Development Certificate drawings, building regulations and the technical package, alongside the interior scheme. The palette was deliberately kept away from the grey and white that is standard at this level of the rental market, using oak, cream, terracotta and mustard throughout.
The project is complete and gives the property a clear point of difference in a crowded professional letting market.
